{{Quote|Take your recent comments to Senator Vuub regarding the policies of the Resource Management Council. We may all agree that the Republic's handling of the current crisis is less than perfect, but anything short of the utmost political discipline is unforgivable at this time. Do you understand?|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nikil Nobil]]|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
'''Vuub''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Alliance" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> she spoke with [[Shigar Konshi]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], and her flattery led Konshi to share his opinions on how the [[Resource Management Council]] was corrupt and ineffective&mdash;comments that directly led to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council's]] determination that Konshi was unfit to take the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]].<ref name="Alliance" />
